summary.answer: Accept str_type,str_scenedef and implicit self for the fallback. Choose get_scenedef(str_scenedef) when the explicit name is defined; otherwise call get_scenedef(self.scriptbundlename). Set n_count to 0 after that fetch. Iterate every s_scenedef.objects element; only elements with defined type evaluate tolower(type)==tolower(str_type), and each match increments n_count once. Return the count after the loop. No skip for disabled objects or active-player/runtime checks exists locally. No guard validates the returned definition, objects container, str_type, self or string types.

summary.answer: This is the cscriptbundlebase class method error(condition,str_msg), not a global error function. On false condition return false without other work. On true condition, truthy _testing takes an empty branch; otherwise synchronously call assertmsg with _s.type, opaque dev separators, hashtostring(_str_name) and str_msg concatenated. If execution reaches the next statement, launch a new on_error thread on the implicit object context, then return true. Do not assume assertmsg returns: native assertion behavior may prevent the later launch/return. The on_error call can involve class dispatch/overrides; the declaration candidates are recorded separately without claiming the actual dynamic implementation. No error state is assigned by this body itself.
